boundary: Deterministic read-only evidence projection for a target repository. It does not execute repository code, install MCP, score architecture quality, or claim field maturity.
reference_boundary: OpenAI and secondary Harness sources are citation metadata and governance references only. This contract promotes platform-neutral repository evidence checks and must not enable Codex bindings, hosted models, external MCP servers, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.
